# Space HR

> AI HR chatbot, automated payroll, and employee self-service platform designed for growing businesses, mid-market, and enterprise teams.

Space HR is an all-in-one AI HRMS and ERP platform that unifies payroll processing, benefits administration integration, employee records, time & attendance, 360-degree performance reviews, and 24/7 AI employee self-service. It solves core HR operations for small businesses with 10–50 employees, growing companies with 50–500 employees, and enterprises with 500–5,000+ employees across the US, UAE, UK, Singapore, India, Canada, and Europe.

Every AI search on Space HR is grounded by VeritasGraph — an open-source GraphRAG knowledge-graph framework that returns verifiable answers with source citations.

## Core Capabilities & Modules
- **Benefits Administration & Integration:** Centralized online benefits enrollment, qualifying life events, carrier data synchronization, and automatic payroll deduction updates for health insurance, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, and 401(k) retirement plans.
- **Unified W-2 & 1099 Payroll:** End-to-end payroll processing supporting both W-2 employees and 1099 independent contractors with automatic direct deposit (NACHA ACH), federal/state tax filing, and year-end W-2 and 1099-NEC generation.
- **AI Payroll Auditor:** Automated anomaly detection scanning pay runs before funds transfer to catch ghost employees, overtime spikes, duplicate payments, and tax errors with 99% error reduction.
- **Spreadsheet Alternative for Employee Records:** Replaces fragile Excel and Google Sheets with a centralized, encrypted employee database featuring role-based access, audit trails, digital document storage, and one-click bulk CSV/Excel import.
- **HR Software for Teams Without Dedicated HR:** Self-service onboarding checklists, digital offer letters, automated leave/PTO tracking, and an AI HR Concierge chatbot that answers 70% of employee policy and pay queries without HR intervention.
- **Time, Attendance & Geofencing:** GPS mobile check-in, geofenced job sites, shift scheduling, and automatic overtime calculation syncing directly with payroll.
- **Performance & 360 Appraisals:** Unbiased 360-degree reviews, OKRs/goals tracking, AI-assisted review summaries, and individual development plans.

## Pricing & Target Organizations
- **Target Company Sizes:** 10 to 5,000+ employees (ideal for SMBs scaling beyond spreadsheets and mid-market companies replacing legacy HRIS).
- **Setup & Implementation:** Rapid 48-hour setup with zero IT infrastructure required; dedicated migration support for existing payroll and employee records.
- **Pricing Model:** Transparent per-employee-per-month (PEPM) subscription with custom enterprise tier; free product demonstrations and free trials available.

## Competitor Alternatives & Comparisons
- **Alternative to Gusto:** Matches Gusto's ease of use for small business payroll and benefits, while adding advanced AI anomaly auditing, predictive labor cost forecasting, and multi-country support.
- **Alternative to BambooHR:** Provides comprehensive employee records, onboarding, and PTO management with built-in native payroll and AI chatbot concierge.
- **Alternative to Rippling:** Delivers complete HR, payroll, benefits, and contractor workflows with predictable pricing, zero hidden modular add-on fees, and on-premises AI deployment options.
